scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,blue "tsx watch backend/src/index.ts" "vite --config frontend/vite.config.ts"
scripts.build: tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.test: tsx --test backend/src/utils/core.test.ts backend/src/adapters/adapters.test.ts tests/shake.test.ts tests/nearby.test.ts tests/hospitals.test.ts tests/hospital-ui.test.ts tests/emergency.test.ts tests/search-location.test.ts tests/saved-places.test.ts tests/hospital-recovery.test.ts tests/modal-lock.test.ts tests/tour-live.test.ts tests/public-data.test.ts tests/help-location.test.ts tests/map-layers.test.ts tests/toilet-geocoding.test.ts tests/visit-facilities.test.ts tests/suitability.test.ts tests/visit-guidance.test.ts tests/visit-plans.test.ts tests/visit-question-draft.test.ts tests/help-handoff.test.ts tests/offline.test.ts tests/android-app.test.ts
scripts.build:android:web: tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts --mode android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android:web && cap sync android
